## Purpose
The header notification bell. It lists runs that completed or failed and runs waiting for a review, each with a button straight to it.

## Responsibilities
- A popover lists the notifications (`Row`), with mark-read and clear.
- `useDesktopPermission` asks for browser notification permission.

## Key elements
`NotificationsIndicator`.
